title: Amount of a Billing-Error Correction Credit on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Late Fee
content:
**Clause.** The billing-error correction credit on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement returns the agreement's standard late fee and adds a service-recovery amount to it.

1. *Standard late fee.* The standard late fee is the greater of the class's flat late fee and the class's late-fee percentage of the contracted monthly rent, the percentage amount rounded to the cent, never more than the class's late-fee ceiling (the three figures of the space class's rate card).
2. *Service-recovery amount.* The service-recovery amount is the service-recovery share of 2% multiplied by the agreement's contracted monthly rent, compared with the service-recovery ceiling of $10.00, the lower of the two kept, and rounded to the cent.
3. *Credit.* The correction credit is the standard late fee plus the service-recovery amount, rounded to the cent.

### Worked figures (hypothetical rents)

| Step | Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft), rent $260.00 (rate card: $30.00 flat, 15%, $60.00 ceiling) | Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage, rent $640.00 (rate card: $35.00 flat, 10%, $75.00 ceiling) |
|---|---|---|
| Percentage amount | 15% of $260.00 is $39.00 | 10% of $640.00 is $64.00 |
| Greater of flat fee and percentage amount | $39.00 | $64.00 |
| Kept within the late-fee ceiling | $39.00 | $64.00 |
| 2% of the contracted monthly rent | $5.20 | $12.80 |
| Lower of that and $10.00 | $5.20 | $10.00 |
| Correction credit | $44.20 | $74.00 |

### Points of judgement

- The late fee returned is the standard late fee of the class on the contracted monthly rent, worked out afresh, not the figure that happens to stand on the erroneous entry.
- The $10.00 limit applies to the service-recovery amount only; the standard late fee returned is limited by the class's own late-fee ceiling.
